about: Ad Shield's own scriptlet rules (MIT). Each rule: hosts (each covers its subdomains) and scriptlets ([name, ...string args]) from src/scriptlets/lib.js. Built into build/scriptlets-main.js by tools/build.py; shipped in the package, never downloaded. Object paths and URL patterns: docs/research-v2.md section B.

rules.about: Ad data removed before the player sees it: the page-embedded player response and initial data (setter traps), every JSON.parse / Response.json (player keys always; feed and Shorts ad items only in API responses, which have responseContext), and the youtubei fetch / XHR responses. Plus the onAbnormalityDetected reporter defused and the web_streaming_watch flag off (research B recipe 1-7).
